title: Calculate the average home team goal in the 2010/2011 season in the country
question: Calculate the average home team goal in the 2010/2011 season in the country of Poland.

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT AVG(cm.home_team_goal)
FROM country_match AS cm
JOIN League AS l ON cm.league_id = l.id
WHERE cm.season = '2010/2011'
  AND l.name = 'Poland Ekstraklasa'
